Lovely lunch spot
Apr 2025 • Solo
Had been to the Hang Mua cave/viewpoint and spotted this place on the road leading up to it. It looked inviting, so I decided to stop off on the way back for some lunch. I'm really glad I did. 

Wonderful service. The lady serving us was lovely, and the food was equally good. I had the tacos (one of each, to try them all). All three were equally delicious and tasted really fresh.

Their cakes looked amazing, so I bought a piece to bring home with me, and can very much vouch for the chocolate and banana cake. Mmmm.
